payload.content: If the question requires a numeric computation (count, sum, ratio, difference, percentage), first write the arithmetic in plain English referencing the schema columns (e.g., 'COUNT of rows WHERE x=1 / COUNT of all rows * 100'), then translate that expression into the SQL. Show the arithmetic plan before the SQL.
Place the plain-English arithmetic plan in the `arith_plan` field. The `sql_query` field must contain only the final SQL with no preamble or narration.

payload.name: arith_plan
payload.description: Plain-English arithmetic plan referencing schema columns, written before the SQL.

rationale: Adapter of tabfact's rt_aggregation_arithmetic_shown mechanism (proven +0.105 on superlative-no) to bird SQL — tests whether explicit arithmetic-shape reasoning before SQL composition lifts arithmetic-related slices.
